name: csscheck
description: Playwright verification of the old-browser compat CSS (both stylesheets are maintained sources; see decisions/0008). clamp.mjs probes served rules against real clamp(); panel2.mjs checks the precomputed elbow table against a live max() rule. Start the app (default http://localhost:8088/, override with CSSCHECK_URL), then: npm run check. First time: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
